newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GOLF-WESTERN PROVINCE CRUSH SOUTHERN TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-WESTERN PROVINCE CRUSH SOUTHERN TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Southern Tansvaal's defence of their inter-provincial golf title began in inauspicious style as they lost their opening singles match to Western Province, 7-1 at Clovelly Country Club on Monday.

Only Andrew McLardy, who defeated Hennie Walters by two holes, could salvage a little pride for the champions in the final pairing of the match. Southern Transvaal also lost the foursomes in the morning by two and a half to one and a half.
In the other 'A' section match Eastern Province and Natal shared both the foursomes and singles.

The results put Western Province clear at the top of the log with two points to one point each for Eastern Province and Natal. Border, the fifth team in the log, begin their challenge on Tuesday against Southern Transvaal after sitting out the opening day.

Southern Transvaal (0 pts) lost to Western Province (2 pts) by two and a half to nine and half. Foursomes: Southern Transvaal one and a half, Western Province two and a half. Singles: Southern Transvaal one, Western Province seven.
Eastern Province (1 pt) drew with Natal (1 pt) six points each. Foursomes: Eastern Province two, Natal two. Singles: Eastern Province four, Natal four.
